title: Bioactive polyketides from cultures of the entomopathogenic fungus Hypocrella luteola TBRC-BCC 76666
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5234-5241
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08431D, Paper

Jittra Kornsakulkarn, Patchanee Auncharoen, Wasana Noisripoom, Suchada Mongkolsamrit, Chawanee Thongpanchang
Six new polyketides (1–6) and two new naturally occurring compounds (7–8), along with seven known compounds, were isolated from the culture extracts of the entomopathogenic fungus Hypocrella luteola strain TBRC-BCC 76666.
